explanation: The rebellion’s own article names the revolution as what it came out of, and dates itself against the revolution’s defeat: “The mutiny was part of the aftermath of the Russian Revolution of 1905, which by summer 1906 had effectively been suppressed in most other regions of the Russian Empire.” A rising in the aftermath of a revolution, a year after it began and in the one garrison where it had not yet been put down, is the revolution working itself out. **This is the only one of the 1905 records this run has imported that earned an edge rather than a filing alone**, and it earned it on that one word, “aftermath”.
